grade_statement.measures: Whether status reporting is current, new, consistent and correctly placed.
grade_statement.does_not_measure: Whether any project will finish on time.

cleanup.subtitle: Record corrections in your own lists. Each line is something you can change yourself, and each project name links to its list. This page is about the record, not the work.

parked.label: Started, then idle
parked.definition: In progress for more than 60 days.
parked.remedy: Move it on, close it, or record why it waits.

no_date_no_owner.label: Started with no date and no owner
no_date_no_owner.definition: In progress with neither a due date nor an assignee.
no_date_no_owner.remedy: Add an owner and a due date, or move it back to not started.

overdue.label: Past its due date
overdue.definition: In progress or queued, with a due date before this read.
overdue.remedy: Finish it, close it, or set the date the team now expects.

no_owner.label: Active with no owner
no_owner.definition: In progress or queued, with no assignee.
no_owner.remedy: Assign it to the person doing the work.

not_started_past_due.label: Not started, past its date
not_started_past_due.definition: Still in a not-started status with a due date before this read.
not_started_past_due.remedy: Start it, re-date it, or close it.

scaffold.label: Unused setup rows
scaffold.definition: A block of not-started rows with no date and no owner.
scaffold.remedy: Remove the rows you will not use, or date and assign the ones you will.

open_raid.label: RAID log still open
open_raid.definition: A RAID log task left open in a finished project.
open_raid.remedy: Close the log, or move any live item to the project that owns it now.

past_due_open.label: Open and past due in a finished project
past_due_open.definition: An open task with a due date before this read, in a finished project.
past_due_open.remedy: Close it, or move it to the project that owns the work now.

open_in_finished.label: Open in a finished project
open_in_finished.definition: Any other open task in a finished project.
open_in_finished.remedy: Close it, or move it to the project that owns the work now.
